sections.summary: The Motion has full support from all sides, and five Ministries will work as a whole-of-Government on seniors' issues, with details at Budget and Committee of Supply.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development and Second Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: We are encouraged that the Motion has full support from all sides of this House.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development and Second Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: And while four of us have responded on behalf of a total of five Ministries, we are fully committed to working as a whole-of-Government, to coordinate on seniors' issues, to prepare ahead and prepare well and to implement effectively.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development and Second Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: We will share more details of specific plans at the upcoming Budget and Committee of Supply debates.

sections.label: LPAs, family tribunal, property transfers
sections.summary: Cheryl Chan encourages seniors over 55 to sign up for LPAs; Rahayu Mahzam and Chia Yong Yong suggest the Tribunal for Maintenance of Family do more, and Chia Yong Yong suggests children benefiting from property transfers be responsible for parents.

sentences.speaker: Mr Kwek Hian Chuan Henry
sentences.text: At the same time, we must plan for unexpected situations, and that is why Miss Cheryl Chan encourages seniors over 55 to sign up for LPAs.

sentences.speaker: Mr Kwek Hian Chuan Henry
sentences.text: Both Ms Rahayu Mahzam and Ms Chia Yong Yong suggest that the Tribunal for Maintenance of Family can do more and move into education and counselling as well as to be bolder in enforcement.

sentences.speaker: Mr Kwek Hian Chuan Henry
sentences.text: Ms Chia Yong Yong also came up with an excellent idea, which is, to make children who benefit from transfer of property responsible for their parents.

sections.label: Reverse mortgages beyond 4-Room flats
sections.summary: Rahayu Mahzam, Gan Thiam Poh and Chia Yong Yong spoke about encouraging more reverse mortgages and extending them beyond 4-Room HDB flats.

sentences.speaker: Mr Kwek Hian Chuan Henry
sentences.text: Ms Rahayu Mahzam, Mr Gan Thiam Poh and Ms Chia Yong Yong spoke about encouraging more reverse mortgages and extending it beyond 4-Room HDB flats.

sections.label: More CHAS discounts for Baby Boomers
sections.summary: Rahayu Mahzam and Joan Pereira asked for more CHAS discounts for Baby Boomers and for a broader group of seniors.

sentences.speaker: Mr Kwek Hian Chuan Henry
sentences.text: Ms Rahayu Mahzam and Ms Joan Pereira asked for us to do more for Baby Boomers through more CHAS discounts, and for a broader group of seniors.

sections.label: Nationwide CNS rollout and senior volunteers
sections.summary: Rahayu Mahzam, Joan Pereira and Cheng Li Hui called for a nationwide rollout of the CNS programme, and Tin Pei Ling suggested conscripting all Singaporeans as volunteers two days a month.

sentences.speaker: Mr Kwek Hian Chuan Henry
sentences.text: As such, Ms Rahayu Mahzam, Ms Joan Pereira and Miss Cheng Li Hui called for a nationwide rollout of the successful CNS programme.

sentences.speaker: Mr Kwek Hian Chuan Henry
sentences.text: Ms Tin Pei Ling also contributed the refreshing idea to get all Singaporeans conscripted as volunteers to support seniors two days a month, with real vocations, real roles and responsibilities.

sections.label: Innovation and URA developmental controls
sections.summary: The speaker looks forward to continuous Government innovation and appreciates Minister Desmond Lee's promise to relook at the Urban Redevelopment Authority's developmental controls.

sentences.speaker: Mr Kwek Hian Chuan Henry
sentences.text: I look forward to continuous innovation from our Government.

sentences.speaker: Mr Kwek Hian Chuan Henry
sentences.text: I also deeply appreciate Minister Desmond Lee's promise to relook at the Urban Redevelopment Authority's developmental controls.

sections.label: Reverse mortgage service gap
sections.summary: Companies have stopped offering reverse mortgages, creating a gap that will grow.

sentences.speaker: Mr Kwek Hian Chuan Henry
sentences.text: On reverse mortgages, I take the point that companies have stopped offering this service and this is precisely why there is a gap, and this gap will grow.

sections.label: Action Plan and CHAS reviews
sections.summary: Speaker appreciates Amy Khor's and MOH's openness to new ideas and reviews of healthcare financial programmes like CHAS.

sentences.speaker: Mr Kwek Hian Chuan Henry
sentences.text: As the Action Plan continues to roll out, I appreciate Senior of Minister Amy Khor's openness to new ideas.

sentences.speaker: Mr Kwek Hian Chuan Henry
sentences.text: I also appreciate MOH's openness to explore strengthening CNS in the coming Budget and to conduct regular reviews of excellent healthcare financial programmes, such as CHAS.

sections.label: Industrial estates and water investment
sections.summary: Singapore built industrial estates and invested in turning salt water and used water into drinking water.

sentences.speaker: Mr Kwek Hian Chuan Henry
sentences.text: We built whole industrial estates, before companies were interested in coming in.

sentences.speaker: Mr Kwek Hian Chuan Henry
sentences.text: We were one of the few countries that invested in turning salt water to fresh water and used water to drinking water, in anticipation of our future water needs.

sections.label: Nation for All Ages
sections.summary: Speaker calls for appreciation of legacy and a Nation for All Ages where seniors age successfully and in dignity.

sentences.speaker: Mr Kwek Hian Chuan Henry
sentences.text: But we should also grow a deeper sense, an appreciation of legacy.

sentences.speaker: Mr Kwek Hian Chuan Henry
sentences.text: We must build a Nation for All Ages with a healthy respect for legacy and experience, where our seniors age successfully, and in dignity.
